exclusions.name: Elena Cruz
exclusions.why_safe: She oversees receipts but does not control collection or shipping; her actions do not affect the number of units received.

exclusions.name: Other hospitals or blood centres
exclusions.why_safe: The question only concerns St. Vincent regional hospital's receipts from Cascade regional blood centre; other entities are irrelevant.

exclusions.name: Weekend collections or shipments
exclusions.why_safe: The drive is only open Monday to Friday, and shipments are only Tuesday and Thursday; weekend operations are not part of the scenario.

uncertainties.meaning: The exact number of units remaining at the centre after the Tuesday shipment is dispatched is unknown because the collection rates and timings before 4 PM Tuesday are not fully specified.
The number of units collected on Wednesday is unknown because the collection rate is given as an average, but actual hourly collection may vary.
The number of units collected on Thursday before 4 PM is unknown for the same reason.
Whether the centre has at least 150 units to ship on Thursday is uncertain because it depends on the unknown stock after Tuesday and the unknown collections on Wednesday and Thursday.
It is uncertain whether the Thursday shipment actually occurs, as it depends on the centre having enough stock.
If the Thursday shipment is dispatched, it is uncertain whether it arrives before the Friday noon deadline, given the 3-hour travel time and the dispatch at 4 PM Thursday.
